name: Paradisus Palma Real Resort
positioning: All-inclusive beach resort on Playa Bavaro in Punta Cana, officially the Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort, with an adults-only Royal Service area
best_for: Adults who want butler service and private pool and beach areas through Royal Service
Families who want a free Kids Club and a Baby Zone

facts.text: The resort is on Playa Bavaro in Punta Cana and is all-inclusive.
The resort is presided over by the Plaza Colonial.
The lobby has a view of the ocean.
Royal Service guests stay in luxury suites with an in-room Jacuzzi.
The Royal Service Lounge offers private check-in and check-out.
The resort has a pool with 6 hydromassage areas.
Spa specialists emphasize shiatsu techniques, and treatments and decor seem inspired by Southeast Asian spas.
Passion by Martin Berasategui is a restaurant by the Spanish chef.
The Red Lounge has resident DJs.
The Baby Zone welcomes babies over the age of 4 months.
Themed workshops cover cocktails, sushi, cigars and candle making, and there are salsa, bachata and merengue classes.

highlights.text: Royal Service includes personalized butler service, VIP areas throughout the resort, and private areas with Bali beds and concierge service on Playa Bavaro.
The exterior is colonial-meets-tropical, with white pillars, Spanish tiles and cobblestone pathways leading to hidden gardens.
Royal Service guests have a pool overlooking Playa Bavaro with a pool concierge.
The Oriental Garden Spa is influenced by Asian cultures.
The Kids Club is at no extra cost and includes an adventure park.

considerations.text: The hotel is tucked behind a golf course, miles away from civilization.
Royal Service is for guests over the age of 18.
WhataHotel notes it is a large resort with walking distances between facilities.
